name: Bartley
summary: Quieter CCL pocket between Serangoon and Tai Seng — residential stacks with less mall crush than NEX and shorter Circle Line hops toward the city.
body: Bartley suits renters who want Circle Line access without living inside Serangoon’s interchange crowds. Housing mixes HDB and condo inserts with a calmer evening profile than Kovan Hub; errands often lean on Serangoon or Tai Seng rather than a giant on-doorstep mall. Expats shortlist it for door-to-desk math into CCL office belts and relative value versus Lorong Chuan condo premiums. Walk the exact block twice: some stacks sit closer to major roads or school traffic. Compare with Lorong Chuan when you want Serangoon mall gravity closer, Kovan when NEL + hawker hub matters more, and Tai Seng when industrial-edge CCL living is acceptable.
